source.description: Carries each package's source hash to its dependents, so a check reruns when a package it loads changes, without waiting for that package's checks.

typecheck.description: Every project checks its own sources with --noEmit and reads its dependencies' sources directly, so no check waits on another's, and reruns when a package it loads changes, the submodule's grizzle packages among them; grizzle's packages keep their own gates.

superlint.description: The dev tools' rules and den's toolchain.config.ts are inputs too.

oxlint.description: The dev tools' preset and plugin and den's toolchain.config.ts are inputs too.
